claims.claim: This is a dirt 4 shockwave sport bicycle with dual biggest suspemsion, dual disc brake & gear system
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a red-and-white mountain bike with front suspension fork and disc brake visible at the front (rear disc only possibly). Gears are mentioned by seller, but the witness did not confirm drivetrain/gear shifting or rear disc clearly.
No receipt/date, serial/brand/model plate, or usage evidence shown in the witness report.
Witness report does not include a test of gear shifting or brake responsiveness; only disc brake presence is noted.
Witness report does not show close-ups of rust-prone areas (chain, spokes, rotor surfaces, fasteners) or confirm originality.

risks.risk: Motorized/bottom-bracket motor may not run or may be incomplete (wiring/carb/filters missing or faulty).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the motor starting and running under load (riding or wheel spin) plus a close-up showing the full motor setup (carb/air filter, wiring, and any controller/battery if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-working or untested motorized bike (worst case: treat motor as not functional).

risks.risk: Rear disc brake and true 'dual disc' may not actually be present/working.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear wheel hub/rotor area and a clip showing both front and rear brakes engaging (wheel stops).
risks.if_unproven: Price as front disc only (worst case: rear brake not present or not functional).

risks.risk: Gear system may not shift smoothly (worn chain/cassette, bent derailleur, misadjustment).
risks.proof: Video clip shifting through all gears while stationary and then briefly while moving; close-up of drivetrain (chain + sprockets).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested gears' with possible drivetrain wear (worst case: assume shifting issues).

risks.risk: Tires/tubes may be worn or leaking; sidewall cracks not visible from one angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread depth and sidewalls + check/clip showing tire holds air (or pump pressure test).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires/tubes may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Brake condition may be poor even if rotors exist (pads worn, rotor warped, weak braking).
risks.proof: Close-up of brake pads/rotors and a clip showing strong braking from a short roll.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'brakes need service' (worst case: pads/rotors replacement).

risks.risk: Frame alignment/hidden cracks or dents not visible in a single photo angle.
risks.proof: Multiple photos: full frame from both sides, head tube area, bottom bracket, and weld/joint close-ups; plus a straight-edge/inspection clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing frame inspection/repair (worst case: treat as unknown structural condition).

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact specifications are unclear; 'shockwave dirt 4' may be inaccurate or not verifiable.
risks.proof: Photo of any readable brand/model nameplate/serial number on frame or motor unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on generic motorized mountain bike condition/specs (worst case: no premium for brand/model).

proof_requests: Video of the motor starting and running (and ideally a short ride or wheel-spin under power).
Clear photos of the rear brake rotor/hub area to confirm true dual disc.
Video showing gear shifting through all gears (stationary and briefly moving).
Close-up photos of drivetrain (chain, sprockets/cassette, derailleur) and brake pads/rotors.
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls; confirm tires hold air.
Photos of frame from multiple angles plus any serial/model plate on frame or motor unit.
response.reason: The witness confirms a motorized mountain bike with front suspension and front disc brake, but key value drivers (motor working status, rear disc certainty, gear shifting, brake performance, tire condition, and exact model/spec) are not proven by the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be too uncertain to set confidently.
